title: UAPI: key_fd reserved check accepts any negative, doc says must be -1
description: In ioctl_init, the check for the reserved key_fd field is 'if (op.key_fd >= 0) return -EINVAL'. This accepts any negative value (-2, -100, etc.), but the UAPI comment and struct doc both say 'must be -1'. The code and the ABI specification disagree. If a future version assigns meaning to key_fd == -2 (e.g., 'use key from process keyring'), callers who accidentally passed other negative values get no rejection today, creating ambiguity. Fix: tighten the check to 'if (op.key_fd \!= -1) return -EINVAL' so the kernel enforces exactly what the documentation promises.
